Help with a disability certificate (UDID card) - anyone with a disability of 40% or more, any age
Aids and appliances (wheelchairs, hearing aids, crutches, white canes) - people with a UDID card and family income under ₹22,500 a month
Help applying for the disability pension - adults 18+ with 40% or more disability
Physiotherapy for children - children under 14 with cerebral palsy or a movement disability

Disability certificate: Aadhaar card, two passport photos, any doctor's reports. Aids and appliances: UDID card, income certificate, Aadhaar card. Disability pension: UDID card, bank passbook, Aadhaar card. Physiotherapy: any doctor's reports.
